1.consolidated_definition: Según Bachiller y Morales, ana significaba ‘flor’, y en palabra compuesta se entendía como cosa principal o centro.
1.en_consolidated_definition: According to Bachiller and Morales, ana signified 'flower', and in compound words it was understood as the main thing or center.
